unit.name: Claude prep fold
unit.responsibility: Harden ClaudePrepFold into product: reference-parser rules (per-source-generation dedupe on (message.id, requestId) with per-field max; repeats across batches or runs become update sightings; cache_creation 1h/5m split with the documented fallback main→1h, subagent→5m and cache_write_basis; <synthetic> assistant records are limit_notice events, never calls; per-call gap from the preceding new call; turn origin precedence and sender precedence exactly as extract.py); typed events (compaction trigger/pre/post/duration, recap, scheduled_fire → loop origin, limit_notice with resets_at_ms when the record timestamp and phrase allow, queue_op, model_switch from the native /model command record); stop_reason; tool_uses (native name, family, input hash/bytes, result offset/bytes, outcome, native duration); sidechain parent link; SessionFacts incl. latest_context, compactions, last_compaction.first_context_after, last_model_switch; content only under include_content; versioned checkpoint.
unit.interface: ClaudePrepFold: PrepFold (harness "claude-code", policy "claude-code/prep-v3", kind Append, pattern "**/*.jsonl").
unit.notes: Fixtures are synthetic and content-free (fabricated ids, short placeholder texts). Behavioural tests cover every rule above plus batch-split and checkpoint-resume equivalence. The POC's reference-parity knowledge (window boundary state, 0.1 s gap rounding at ties) is documented in the fold, not hidden; real-corpus parity is the PM's vd-000a.

instructions: You may read crates/core/src/prep.rs, crates/core/src/lib.rs, crates/testkit/src/prep.rs (owner tk-0001); immutable plan docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/plan.dd.json and guide docs/plans/028-prep-canonical-tables/assets/impl-guide.dd.json.

Your job: Harden ClaudePrepFold into product: reference-parser rules (per-source-generation dedupe on (message.id, requestId) with per-field max; repeats across batches or runs become update sightings; cache_creation 1h/5m split with the documented fallback main→1h, subagent→5m and cache_write_basis; <synthetic> assistant records are limit_notice events, never calls; per-call gap from the preceding new call; turn origin precedence and sender precedence exactly as extract.py); typed events (compaction trigger/pre/post/duration, recap, scheduled_fire → loop origin, limit_notice with resets_at_ms when the record timestamp and phrase allow, queue_op, model_switch from the native /model command record); stop_reason; tool_uses (native name, family, input hash/bytes, result offset/bytes, outcome, native duration); sidechain parent link; SessionFacts incl. latest_context, compactions, last_compaction.first_context_after, last_model_switch; content only under include_content; versioned checkpoint.

Done means Claude cost correctness: calls are deduplicated on (message.id, requestId) with the per-field maximum; cache writes are split into 1 h and 5 m classes (with the documented fallback); `<synthetic>` records become limit events, not calls. The file-F and all four window totals in the consumer's use-case brief, and every reference call row, reproduce exactly against the reference parser; any divergence is explained and accepted by the reviewer, not rounded. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0004); Typed facts, not blobs: compaction boundaries (trigger, pre/post tokens, duration), recaps, scheduled/loop fires, limit notices (with parsed reset instants where the source allows), and queue operations are typed events. Turns carry the opening record's origin (human, peer with sender and Pij message identity, task notification, auto-continuation). Sidechains link to their parent session. Tool uses are a table (native name, family, input hash, result size, outcome, duration where native). (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0005); Privacy and safety: metadata-only by default; any content column needs explicit opt-in and is absent otherwise. Native stores are opened read-only and never locked, renamed or written; tests and committed fixtures contain no real prompts, bodies or private identifiers. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-000b). Interface: ClaudePrepFold: PrepFold (harness "claude-code", policy "claude-code/prep-v3", kind Append, pattern "**/*.jsonl")..
